steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Really? Then why'd you block? Save the talk.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Throw us in the ring and I'll have you on the ground in round one.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: How about this, Leto: You gimme another set. You land a good hit, and I give you a prize. Sound good?

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Yeah, not bad. More power in there.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Can you teach me that move?!

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Oh I can teach. But can you learn?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: It's just throwing your fists around a bit. What's to learn?

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: It's a trick I use against those 'bugs' when I'm diggin' out honey. Does good work on the thorny bastards in the ring too.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Oh yeah. Total knockout, every time. How else could it go?

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: If you really wanna learn, head outside and dig out some honey. You'll get it quick.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: The Beehunter's an Ursus who fights for her life. But if we're talkin' about the future? My money's on little Leto.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hehe, now that's what I like to hear.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Okay, break's over, come fight me.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: 'course, if you'd rather take a beating, we can do that too. I'm okay spendin' the rest of our training room time makin' you my punching bag.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Just you wait, Shura. I'm gonna get you this time!

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: If you can't hit me with your fists, why not get a weapon?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: C'mon, I have my pride, Shura.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Although, the training room weapons all have safety features. Getting hit with 'em just hurts a bit.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You grab one too. We'll spar.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Plenty of folks in the ring like polearms.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hum, finally getting serious, are we?

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: There's two ways to deal with somebody using a polearm, you know?

steps.name: Announcement
steps.text: You have——twenty minutes——of time left in this training room. Use your time wisely and prepare the room for use by other operators. Repeat: You have——

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Runnin' outta time. Okay, let's go!

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Don't chug so much water right after training. You'll get midnight cramps.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: That's Future Leto's problem. Right now it feels amazing.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: How 'bout it? You learn something today?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Never, ever get close to a boxer.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: The knucklers are just there to scare ya.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: I only came at you with my shoulders and elbows. Plus you got safety gear. No way you got hurt.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: But I couldn't block you at all, Shura.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What kind of training did you do to get so fast? You have to teach me.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: I fought a lot, I didn't die. Ta-dah.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Take enough beatings and you'll learn how somebody's gonna wanna come at you.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: And if you don't, you get dumpstered pretty quick.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What about me? Am I dumpstered?

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: You've got me and your sisters lookin' out for you. You ever end up in a dumpster, we'll come fish you out.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You say that like I'm garbage.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Hahaha. Don't sweat it, Leto. You're still a kid. Get some experience under your belt and you'll be a lot stronger. No question.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: (Muttering) I even stood up to Reunion.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: (Quietly) Why haven't I heard this before? You're not makin' it up, are ya?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: How about this? Let's go wash up, get something to eat, make ourselves comfortable, and I'll tell you the whole story.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Sounds good. I asked Logistics to make me up a honey drink a couple days ago. Perfect timing.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: And Dur-nar, I hear she did up some wild snacks the other day. Word on the street is she'll sell you some if you give her the password.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Okay. See you back at the dorm.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: (Quietly) What's the password? It was always Gummy and Her Worship who did stuff like this. I dunno how.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Oh, come here, I'll tell ya.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: (Quietly) Listen up. I'm only gonna say it once. Don't ask questions.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: (Quietly) Dur-nar's Snack Network covers all of Rhodes Island. But for security, you can only get access by invitation from somebody the network trusts. I usually work through Haze. She's hella discreet.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: (Quietly) You knock six times. Long, short, long, long, short, long. Get it?

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: (Quietly) Then you make conversation when they open the door. When they say the word 'glockenspiel,' you gotta immediately reply, 'this one's pretty good.' Then you'll get the price and you're golden.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: (Quietly) Don't forget: 'Glockennnspiel,' long in the middle, short at the end.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I gotta go through all that just to get some snacks?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: That's a pain in the ass. I'll just get Gummy to do it.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Shura, I got the——Hey, you started drinking already!

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: I got bored waiting for you. But I bought lots. Why can't I do a little pregaming?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Yeah all right. I actually nibbled on the snacks a bit on my way back. They're good.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: You think the Beehunter would stand for less?

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: C'mon, let's eat, play a hand or two to warm up, and then you tell us about your big adventure.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: You always have shitty luck at cards.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: We're only three or four cans in, and this is non-alcoholic.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: You must be drunk on honey just like me!

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Yeah! And it's hittin' you a lot harder than it hits me.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: And here I thought I was the only one who got honey drunk. Heh, hahahaha!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What're you talking about? The great and mighty Leto would never get *hic* drunk!

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Yes, yes, God-Empress Leto. All hail! Hahahahaha!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What are you laughing at? If we're done with the cards then get over here and listen to the story of Leto the Great.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Yes, Your *snicker* Majesty, Leto the Great. Hehe.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Listen well, Bee——Beehunter. The G-great One speaks.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Right, let's start from the beginning!

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: I'm havin' way too much fun today. I gotta record this.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: To get the Great One something to wet her whistle!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Me. Gummy said you sent her to get snacks. I'm here for my cut.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What? Is there something on the Great... err, my face?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh, honey? N- no. Don't be silly.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Oh Mighty Leto——I've brought your refreshments.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Beehunter, come. Let me ask you something.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: And it's hittin' her way harder than it ever does me. She's supposed to be telling me some story about her adventures before.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: You wanna listen in too? Or I could just record it for ya.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I gotta——nng, I gotta tell her my glorious war stories——

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Yeah, sure, you can have her.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I'm out. Have a good time, Leto.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: C'mon, Leto. Stop standin' in the door makin' a fool of yourself.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Fine, fine. Leto the Great and Mighty, get inside already.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Um, well, I'm sorry to bother you so late. But, if it wouldn't be too much trouble, do you think you could have your conversation inside your room?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: That's exactly what I wanna doooooo.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: I am so sorry about the noise. Lemme just close our door there.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Sure, why not? Go big or go home.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh, huh. Then I guess I better hike up my skirt and start again.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: But I should probably drink something first.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: I could go for another ice soda.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: If only that gang of nobles hadn't taken apart the vending machine.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: Somebody else thinks they can make it out of the campus?

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: The masked dudes just pushed 'em back in. Tsk.

steps.name: Student A
steps.text: Hey, aren't you Rosalind from class 3?

steps.name: Student B
steps.text: We're from the Peterheim Benevolent Society. Our boss, Big Andrey, wants you to join us.

steps.name: Student B
steps.text: How about it? Give it some thought?

steps.name: Student A
steps.text: Are you really turning us down?

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: In the past two days, like four or five different gangs have tried to poach me?

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: I don't even get why we have so many little groups. And they all have such big, tough names.

steps.name: Student B
steps.text: Huh? What's that supposed to mean...?

steps.name: Student A
steps.text: Rosalind, there's kids from a whole bunch of different schools here now. Even a bunch from a noble school got sent to ours.

steps.name: Student A
steps.text: You know how many of our classmates get pushed around by those noble pricks.

steps.name: Student A
steps.text: Isn't it time for us all to band together?

steps.name: Student A
steps.text: Andrey says as long as you come along, he'll treat you right.

steps.name: Student A
steps.text: You'll have food, drinks, anything leftover can go to you too.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: Okay, I agree to your terms.

steps.name: Student B
steps.text: Awesome! Thanks for being so reasonable!

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: Hold on a sec. Don't get too excited.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: You gotta get me what I want.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: Find Sonya and get her to ask me to join.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: That's all you gotta do, and I'll wear your armband.

steps.name: Student A
steps.text: We need to think this one over.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: I deal with these boring punks every day.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: Come on, did I drink that much just now?

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: This is way more fun than talking!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I never had these before. Always too lazy to deal with the shell.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Mm, I never knew these nuts were so good.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: So that means it wasn't just kids from your school in there already?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: They took students from a bunch of different nearby schools and locked them in with us.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Including the gopniks from Her Worship's school.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Sorry, which one are you talking about there?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh, that's Natalya. One of the Ursus girls with us.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I just got used to calling her that.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: She's not a bad girl. But back then she was into some real messed up shit.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hey, Beehunter, do the thing for me again.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: That trick where you crack the nuts with your hands.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: You all suck at putting out fires, but you sure are good at stealing.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: I don't have any food here either. Why are they always coming at me?

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: They're all gopniks from our school.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: None of these punks have armbands. How am I supposed to know if they're with Andrey or Vasily?

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: I'll take a few bits, just to fill my stomach.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: I can't keep going like this. They bug me every night.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: The garbage from #4 took over the cafeteria cold storage, and the other canteen went up in smoke.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: Drinks are gonna be the least of my problems if this keeps up. I won't have food or water.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: What if I went to Sonya?

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: She's already got a couple kids over there, right?

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: She won't mind taking one more.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: Yeah, that's it. That could work.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: I offer up a few cans and she'll let me right in.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: That'll be a little more 'stable' at least.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: Never would've thought the world's second strongest would have to go beg first place for help.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: But I'd be able to get a good night's sleep over there...

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: Hey, Sonya, are you here? I wanna talk to you.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: I, uh, didn't mean... I just wanted to, err, I want to join you.

steps.name: Sonya
steps.text: The ones slumped up against the wall. Take them out for me.

steps.name: Sonya
steps.text: I have to guard this place. I'm protecting them. I can't leave.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: I brought you a few cans. They're yours.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Did you fall in, Shura? Who takes that long in the bathroom?!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Your face is all red too.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Look at you, you can barely talk anymore.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What?! I've still got a story to tell.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Fire? What fire? Where's the fire?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh, oh yeah. Now I remember.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: That life-sized Ursus doll you got, you think you can let me hug her tonight?

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Sure. You can have her right now.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Woah, don't throw her! I can't catch like this!

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: Heh. Is that all you got?

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: Get up, Andrey. Where'd all your big talk go?!

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: Well, at least you won't be hungry.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: Okay, that's the boss down. Anybody else...?

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: *Cough*, all right, so you can fight dirty.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: You think I take one hit to the back of the head and go down like in the movies?

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: Guess this is my food now.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: Naw, we're a team. It's what I'm here for.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: And look, she isn't in great shape right now.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: So it's up to me, as Peterheim's second strongest, toAAAAAAaaaaghh that hurts!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Just a little bit longer. Almost done.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: That Youth Scout training comes in handy, huh?

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: The world's running out of good people. Lucky to have you.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: If that cop had run into kids like you, things would've turned out different.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: (We don't have enough food. Don't have enough people.)

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: (Both the food stores are gone. There's just not enough to eat.)

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: (What if a gang shows up to our door someday?)

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: (I guess I could go talk to the mask dudes?)

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: (No way. What if they turn me into one of those rock-covered monsters?)

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: (I might as well give it a shot.)

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: We don't have much left in the way of rations. I'm gonna go out for more tonight.

steps.name: Anna
steps.text: You can't. You're hurt. If you go out again you'll——

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: I'm tough. I can handle it.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: I won't go far. And I won't take anyone's last bite.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: It's been so long since I've come here. I'm kind of excited.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: This is my old dorm. Why can't I go in?

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: If I was afraid to die, I'd try to find a way out of the school. No reason to come here.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: I'm Rosalind, and I wanna talk to your leader.
I'm scared. Scared to death. But my mouth is still going.
I feel like I'm staring into the mouth of hell for the sake of my own pride.
Why did I think it was a good idea to meet the leader of Reunion again?
Was it because I'd say a few words to him and he'd let us all go, or give us food?
Or was I gonna threaten him?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: And then the little white-haired kid with the creepy smile said a few things to me and let me go.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Something like, 'your suffering has only just begun' or 'enjoy life' or whatever.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: How was I supposed to understand?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Then he let me go, just let me go.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I went back to the classroom and slept for a while. The next day, the mask dudes were gone.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Things didn't get better after that.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: We thought life in the school was rough.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: When we got out, we realized that was just the appetizer.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Those stories, they'll eat you alive.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: And here you said, you said I was honey drunk. You're the drunk one!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Cam't benieve it. You just fall ashleep without saying anything.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Beehunter's asleep, so you get to hear the rest of my story.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I got so, sho mush to say.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: You're gonna ask me what happened?

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: You guzzled honey drink until you were dead drunk, then you stole my big doll, collapsed on top of her, and drooled out everything you drank.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You didn't toss her to me?

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: I'm gonna take out the garbage. You get cleaning.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: I'm out. Don't forget afternoon class!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What did I say to her yesterday?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: That's why I woke up so refreshed today.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Gotta clean up, have breakfast, then find somebody to help me wash this big girl.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'll see about drinking with Beehunter again in a couple days.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Might as well strum a few chords.
